claim.claim-text: 2. The method of claim 1 further comprising: determining a third set of primitives from the plurality of primitives that do not change across the plurality of frames; and encoding the third set of primitives as a single set of one or more grids.
3. The method of claim 2 further comprising: streaming the single set of one or more grids representing the third set of primitives with the first data stream and the second data stream.

4. The method of claim 1 further comprising: defining temporal values for different primitives of the plurality of primitives based on an amount of time or a number of the plurality of frames that each primitive of the different primitives remains unchanged.

5. The method of claim 1 further comprising: classifying the plurality of primitives to a plurality of bins based on a number of frames that each of the plurality of primitives is presented without change across the plurality of frames, wherein said classifying comprises grouping the first set of primitives to a first bin of the plurality of bins and grouping the second set of primitives to a second bin of the plurality of bins.

6. The method of claim 1, wherein generating the first data stream comprises encoding the first set of primitives as different sets of one or more grids across a subset of the plurality of frames covered by the reduced frame rate; and wherein generating the second data stream comprises encoding the second set of primitives with a different set of one or more grids for each frame of the plurality of frames and with the different set of one or more grids for a particular frame of the plurality of frames encoding data of one or more primitives from the second set of primitives that are presented at the particular frame without change.

7. The method of claim 6 further comprising: compressing the different sets of one or more grids from the first data stream at a first frame rate using a video codec; and compressing each different set of one or more grids from the second data stream at a second frame rate using the video codec.

8. The method of claim 6, wherein encoding a particular set of one or more grids for the first data stream comprises: encoding a positional attribute of a different primitive from a subset of the first set of primitives to a different cell of a first grid from the particular set of one or more grids; and encoding a visual characteristic attribute of a different primitive from the subset of the first set of primitives to a corresponding different cell of a second grid from the particular set of one or more grids.
9. The method of claim 6 further comprising: optimizing the first data stream and the second data stream for compression by sorting data in each set of one or more grids for smoothness.

10. The method of claim 1, wherein generating the first data stream comprises encoding positional and visual characteristic attributes of the first set of primitives with the temporal values that specify which of the plurality of frames each primitive of the first set of primitives is presented; and wherein generating the second data stream comprises encoding positional and visual characteristic attributes of the second set of primitives without temporal values.

11. The method of claim 1, wherein streaming the first data stream and the second data stream comprises: streaming a different set of grids associated with the first data stream at a different one of a subset of the plurality of frames, wherein the subset of the plurality of frames comprises fewer frames than the plurality of frames; and streaming a different set of grids associated with the second data stream with a different frame of the plurality of frames.
12. The method of claim 1, wherein streaming the first data stream and the second data stream comprises streaming less data than streaming all data associated with the plurality of primitives.

13. The method of claim 1, wherein said determining comprises: analyzing positional and visual characteristic attributes of the plurality of primitives across pairs of consecutive frames; and differentiating the first set of primitives from the second set of primitives based on said analyzing of the positional and visual characteristic attributes.

14. The method of claim 1, wherein generating the first data stream comprises: encoding a first set of grids with data for a first subset of the first set of primitives that are defined without change in the at least N frames across a first set of the plurality of frames; and encoding a second of grids with data for a second subset of the first set of primitives that are defined without change in the at least N frames across a second set of the plurality of frames.

15. The method of claim 14, wherein encoding the first set of grids comprises defining the temporal values that specify which of the first set of the plurality of frames each primitive of the first subset of primitives is defined without change; and wherein encoding the second set of grids comprises defining the temporal values that specify which of the second set of the plurality of frames each primitive of the second subset of primitives is defined without change.

17. The streaming system of claim 16, wherein the one or more hardware processors are further configured to: determine a third set of primitives from the plurality of primitives that do not change across the plurality of frames; and encode the third set of primitives as a single set of one or more grids.

18. The streaming system of claim 17, wherein the one or more hardware processors are further configured to: stream the single set of one or more grids representing the third set of primitives with the first data stream and the second data stream.

19. The streaming system of claim 16, wherein the one or more hardware processors are further configured to: define temporal values for different primitives of the plurality of primitives based on an amount of time or a number of the plurality of frames that each primitive of the different primitives remains unchanged.
